question: Within a 30 kilometers distance, where can I find a restaurant on the path toward Sin Titulo, San Francisco, CA from Golden Gate Bridge Lookout, Sausalito, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Golden Gate Bridge Lookout%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Sausalito%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sin Titulo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, start_point AS sp, end_point AS ep WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography, 30000) -- within 30 kilometers of the starting point AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(sp.geometry, ep.geometry)::geography, 500)::geography); -- on the path (within 500 meters of the straight line between start and end)
